list.title: Categories
list.subtitle: The names you group your income, expenses and transfers under.

deactivate.question: Deactivate “{{name}}”? You will not be able to use it in new transactions; the ones that use it keep it, and you can reactivate it.

empty.income: You have no income categories yet
empty.expense: You have no expense categories yet
empty.transfer: You have no transfer categories yet
empty.body: Create one to group your transactions of this type.
empty.inactiveBody: When you deactivate a category it shows up here, grouped by type, so you can look it up or reactivate it.
